risks.risk: Microwave magnetron may be weak or failing (heats slowly/unevenly) even if it powers on.
risks.proof: A short video of a cup of water boiling test in microwave mode (e.g., 1 cup water, timed) plus the microwave running.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven performance (worst case: reduced heating/needs service).

risks.risk: Grill function may not heat (broken heating element or thermostat).
risks.proof: A short video of grill mode running with visible heat/temperature behavior (or a grill test item browning) and the grill mode selected.
risks.if_unproven: Price as microwave-only / grill not working.

risks.risk: Door seal/latch issues can cause leakage or failure to start reliably.
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing the door latch/hinge area and a video showing it starts reliably with the door closed; ideally a microwave leakage test report (if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible door/latch issue (worst case: unreliable start).

risks.risk: Unknown exact model/specs (wattage/capacity) affects market value.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating plate/model number sticker (usually inside door frame or rear).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end for generic countertop microwave/grill units.

risks.risk: Potential scam/overclaim: 'working very well' cannot be verified from a single exterior photo.
risks.proof: Proof of operation video (microwave + grill) and clear receipt/warranty card photos with matching brand/model.
risks.if_unproven: Price conservatively as used, unverified condition.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the rating plate/model number (inside door frame or rear).
Video: microwave mode test (timed water heating) showing it running.
Video: grill mode test showing grill heating/browning.
Photos of receipt and warranty card (showing date and matching model/brand).
Close-up photo of door latch/hinge and interior cavity condition.
response.reason: The photo shows a microwave/grill unit, but it does not verify that both microwave and grill modes work, nor does it provide the exact model/specs or warranty/receipt evidence. To price safely in Abuja, the key proof is operation videos for both modes and a clear model/rating plate.
